owner_rules: Done means ALL evidence: implemented as specified (task id), a test that FAILED before and passes now, suites green, measured number vs target, docs regenerated, committed AND pushed to the contract's branch.
Never defer: no "later", "follow-up", "out of scope". If blocked: what blocks, what you tried, what you need; then continue with the next task.
Root cause, then fix: file:line + mechanism. No weakening tests, raising timeouts, skips, relaxed assertions.
No silent scope cuts: never lower targets, caps or test sizes without owner approval.
Never bypass guards: no --no-verify, no bypass env vars, no skip flags.
Deliver continuously: one task per commit, pushed to the contract's branch as it goes green.
Honest reporting: TASK-ID | status | commit | tests | measured vs target | missing.

tasks.description: The addendum (recommendation 2, default agent suitability analysis) asks the planner to state what each task needs and the coordinator to rank the connected resources against it, then make the default assignment without a question to the user. SO-02-A AC02 already gives every task required capabilities; SO-08-A decides eligibility (claims, leases, dependencies) and does not score suitability. This contract fixes the content of the required capabilities, adds a suitability record per eligible resource built from the capability records of SO-05-B, availability, workload and policy (SO-03-A), and records the default assignment as an event with its ranked reasons. A task nothing can perform moves to BLOCKED with the missing capability named. Provider-specific knowledge stays in the client registry.

stop_rules: Stop and post BLOCKED when a criterion cannot pass without weakening a test, skipping a test or relaxing an assertion.
Stop and ask when the work would name a client product, a person, a server or a seat in repository text; the client names live in docs/CLIENTS.md only.
Stop when the work would add a runtime dependency, a model call, a network call at install or start, a second store for project state, or any reporting that is not opt-in and off by default.
Stop when the work would move convergence logic into the core, vendor the engine, or add a merge engine beside the provider boundary of src/engine/merge.mjs.
If any criterion fails after the fix: STOP, report the measured result, the failing check and file:line. Do not start the next task.
If the work needs a path outside scope: STOP and ask the owner to amend the contract. Never widen scope silently.

title: SO-A-02 Default agent suitability analysis: capability requirements per task, suitability records per eligible resource, the default assignment recorded with reasons, the user never asked to match
request: Build layer of the Scope One programme, adapted from the unsigned fold of 30 Oct 2026 (fold id SO-A-02) and validated against memev main at d1c65ef. Contracts marked with a dagger are signed in the owner's vault and are not visible in this repository; they are cited by id only. Implements the design record SO-1.03 (Lead assignment: a default suitability analysis and an in-language user preference) (contracts/scope-one/specs). The decision record cites this contract by id and keeps only the gaps this one does not cover. Builds on signed vault contracts: SO-02-A†, SO-03-A†, SO-05-B†, SO-08-A†, SO-L-A†. Memev contracts that land first: SO-1.01. Source in the fold: #222 recommendation 2 (default agent suitability analysis) and recommendation 3 (provider selection is internal). Settled decisions this contract follows (owner decision 31 Oct 2026, docs/scope-one/DECISIONS.md): topology is local-first and the cloud is only a relay and a backup; every supported provider stands on equal footing and no work or tier depends on one; crdt-merge is reached only through the provider boundary of src/engine/merge.mjs (docs/EXTENSION-POINTS.md) and this contract adds no merge engine to the core; tiers follow docs/PRICING.md (Free core, Personal for up to 3 computers with no per-computer add-on, higher tiers by contacting us) with no Personal trial; the git backup keeps running every few minutes (sync.interval_min). Memory authority: ADR 7 (memory and project-state authority) is proposed in PR #325 and is not decided here; this contract cites it and the local-first decision, and keeps one store under the vault with no second database. Provenance: adapted from the unsigned fold of 30 Oct 2026. Changes: (1) converted from the vault task format to the memev spec format (named tests run as red-green checks on the own test file of the contract; inline regular expression flags became the flags key; hygiene and decision verifiers became commands or doc checks). (2) removed fold-only fields and the owner-decision marker field, reworded the stop rule that named a patent, and made the text pass the leak scan. (3) AC04 would fail on main as written: provider names occur outside src/cli/clients.mjs today (src/engine/bus.mjs, devices.mjs, hooks.mjs and the importers). The scan is scoped to the files this contract adds or changes. (4) Prerequisite SO-1.01 added (the suitability record is written through the wired coordinator).
